metadata.data_source: Official Government of India Scheme Circulars (myScheme & Ministry of Finance)

PMJDY.name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना)
PMJDY.description: National Mission for Financial Inclusion to ensure access to financial services, namely, basic savings & deposit accounts.
benefits: Accident Insurance Cover of Rs. 2 Lakhs with RuPay Card
Overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000 for eligible accounts after satisfactory operation
documents: Aadhaar Card (If address changed, self-declaration of current address is sufficient)
Or any Officially Valid Document (OVD) like Voter ID, Driving License, Passport, NREGA Job Card

PMSBY.name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना)
PMSBY.description: Accident insurance scheme offering accidental death and disability cover.
benefits: Rs. 2 Lakh cover for accidental death or total permanent disability
Rs. 1 Lakh cover for partial permanent disability
Premium of Rs. 20 per annum auto-debited annually in May/June

PMJJBY.name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना)
PMJJBY.description: Life insurance scheme offering cover for death due to any cause.
benefits: Rs. 2 Lakh cover for death due to any cause
Premium of Rs. 436 per annum auto-debited annually in May/June

APY.name: Atal Pension Yojana (अटल पेंशन योजना)
APY.description: Pension scheme focused on unorganized sector workers.
benefits: Guaranteed minimum pension of Rs. 1,000, 2,000, 3,000, 4,000 or 5,000 per month after age 60
Pension to spouse after subscriber's death, and return of accumulated pension corpus to nominee
documents: Atal Pension Yojana Registration / Mandate Form

SSY.name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (सुकन्या समृद्धि योजना)
SSY.description: Small deposit scheme for the girl child, part of Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign.
benefits: High interest rate of 8.2% per annum (for Q2 2026)
Maturity after 21 years from account opening or at marriage after age 18
documents: Birth Certificate of the Girl Child (mandatory)
Aadhaar Card of the Parent / Guardian
PAN Card of the Parent / Guardian
Proof of Address (if not same as Aadhaar)
Recent Photograph of the Parent / Guardian
